v1 91.542/91.544. THROUGH THE STATIC: soulful vocal house, 121 -> 121.5 bpm, C# minor.
- The voice (chirp's voice engine, long gospel notes on the stair's ends: C# .. G#, G# .. E, E .. B, F# .. C#) is the CONTINUITY ILLUSION. Its notes are cut out under bursts of radio static (a gain lane on the voice track, so the voice itself never stops), every beat in A1, every other beat in A2, on a 3-3-2 in the break. The ear hears it sing on through the noise. At the peak the static clears and the voice really does sing on, whole.
- Drawbar organ on C#m9 Amaj7 E6 G#m7, eight bars each (t7's progression carried on).
- Rumble kick, claps, hats, shakers, a 3-3-2 rim; a rolling bass.
- SEAMS: in, a bass swap under t7's clicks, with the organ holding C# and G# (the octave-illusion tones' pitch classes). Out: kick, hats and a held C#m organ chord with G# on top for t9 (mixplan rows filled).
-11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, run 1. (Not queued.)
